title: Physically Admissible Generative Flow Matching for Sparse Flow Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.22549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reconstructing full fluid velocity fields from sparse, localized observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem: most of the spatial domain remains unobserved, discrete conservation laws must hold strictly, and predictive uncertainty must be reliable. Existing generative models typically enforce physical constraints only at the terminal output or via soft penalties, leaving intermediate generative trajectories unconstrained. We introduce Feasible Subspace Consistency (FSC), a framework that preserves physical admissibility as an invariant of continuous generative dynamics: tangent-space matching confines the entire ODE trajectory to the discrete conservation manifold, while mass-orthonormal coordinates preserve the kinetic-energy metric. translated_title: 用于稀疏流场重构的物理可行生成流匹配
translated_abstract: 从稀疏、局部的观测数据重构完整的流体速度场是一个严重的病态逆问题：大部分空间区域未被观测、离散守恒定律必须严格成立、且预测不确定性必须可靠。现有的生成模型通常仅在最终输出端施加物理约束或采用软惩罚方式，导致中间生成轨迹不受约束。我们提出了可行子空间一致性，这是一个将物理可行性作为连续生成动力学不变量来保持的框架：切空间匹配将整个常微分方程（ODE）轨迹限制在离散守恒流形上，同时质量正交归一坐标系保持动能度量。稀疏重构随后被转化为在冻结的FSC先验潜空间中的摊销后验输运，确保每个后验样本都继承不可压缩性和边界条件……
tldr: 该论文提出可行子空间一致性框架，通过切空间匹配将整个生成ODE轨迹约束在离散守恒流形上并保持动能度量，使稀疏流场重构中每个后验样本都严格满足不可压缩性与边界条件等物理可行性要求。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Feasible Subspace Consistency (FSC), a generative flow matching framework that preserves physical admissibility as an invariant of the entire generative ODE trajectory, ensuring every posterior sample for sparse flow reconstruction inherits incompressibility and boundary conditions.
